content.text: {"story":"Asha started as a schoolteacher, spent two years building a reading app on weekends, and now runs a small studio making learning tools for rural schools.","facts":[{"text":"Taught middle-school science for six years before building software","sourceUrl":"https://asha.example/about"},{"text":"Launched a free offline reading app used in village schools","sourceUrl":"https://asha.example/projects/reader"}],"recentWork":[{"title":"Why offline-first matters in rural classrooms (talk)","url":"https://talks.example/asha-offline-first","date":"2026-10-12"}],"questions":["What were you doing right before you started building the reading app?","What was the moment you decided to leave teaching?","What did the in-between years feel like, day to day?","Who helped you most when it was uncertain?","What did you have to unlearn as a teacher turned builder?","What would you tell a teacher thinking about building something?","What are you still figuring out today?","What question do you wish people asked you more?"],"limited":false,"sources":["https://asha.example/about","https://asha.example/projects/reader","https://talks.example/asha-offline-first"]}
